title.narrative: RECOVERING LEARNING LOSSES FROM COVID-19 PANDEMIC IN BRAZIL

description.narrative: The objective of the Operation is to support states and municipalities in the Borrower's North and Northeast Regions to: (i) recover from school dropouts and learning losses related to the COVID-19 pandemic, and (ii) strengthen education management in primary and lower secondary schools.

This operation aims to support local governments in the North and Northeast Brazil on the COVID-19 response in education. It has two components: (i) Component 1 (PforR) "Recovery" includes a set of programs designed by the Ministry of Education to recover school dropouts and learning losses caused by the pandemic; and (ii) Component 2 (IPF) "Resilience and Capacity Building" which strengthens the local management capacity of governments to cope with the ongoing pandemic and future natural disasters and crises. Component 2 is composed by highly specialized consultancies, the provision of decentralized teams to support local governments, the development of Ecosystems and EMIS, infrastructure for internet connectivity and devices.
